opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 - £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only. Match funding required. University Development Office coordinates applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to improve research infrastructure at research-intensive universities and research institutions. Two funding rounds per year (Round 1 and Round 2).

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 - £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance (Grade I, II* or Scheduled Monument in England/Wales; Category A, B or Scheduled Monument in Scotland; Grade A, B+ or Scheduled Monument in NI). UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at historic buildings and landscapes with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 - £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 - £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 - £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts constituting the vast majority of activities. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 - £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 - £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants (new building, refurbishment or equipment) helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 - £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants (new building, refurbishment or equipment) for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 - £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC if applicable. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants (new building, refurbishment or equipment) for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £50,000 - £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or hospice operating within the NHS, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent if applicable. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants (new building, refurbishment or equipment) for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 - £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity or local authority running special schools/colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'good' rating from a regulator if applicable. Project must include capital costs of at least £50,000. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants (new building, refurbishment or equipment) for special schools and colleges supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living after school/college. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; maximum grant amount £100,000; usual range £15,000-£50,000 (equipment), £15,000-£100,000 (new build/refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK, with at least two years of exam results, 'Good' or above inspection rating, and able to demonstrate excellence. Project must cost at least £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment or technical equipment) helping state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
